jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer (Robotics / Systems)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Forward-Deployed Engineer to work directly at the intersection of customers, software, and physical robotic systems. This role is about closing the last 10%: taking cutting-edge robotics software and making it work reliably in real-world environments. You’ll partner closely with end users to understand their workflows, deploy systems in the wild, and translate real-world constraints into product and engineering improvements. While experience with physical hardware is a plus, our core mission is to dramatically lower the barrier to deploying robots — strong software engineers with customer-facing experience are encouraged to apply.

Core Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and adapt the Dimensional robotics platform in real-world customer environments.

  • Partner directly with users to gather requirements, understand operational constraints, and identify edge cases encountered in production.

  • Serve as a key interface between product, engineering, and customers, ensuring tight feedback loops and rapid iteration.

  • Own end-to-end real-world implementations, from initial system setup and validation through stable, long-term operation.

  • Contribute production-quality, maintainable code to the core platform codebase, informed by deployment learnings.

  • Help define, document, and standardize best practices for deploying and operating robotic systems at scale.

What We Look For

  • Prior experience in forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to design, implement, and maintain production-quality systems.

  • Comfort working with real-world systems characterized by incomplete information, hardware constraints, and operational uncertainty.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into well-defined technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience deploying and operating physical hardware systems in real-world environments.

  • Professional background at forward-deployed or deployment-intensive organizations (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, or similar).

  • Prior exposure to robotics, embedded systems, automation, or related physical systems domains.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff – Agents
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

About The Role

We’re hiring an LLM Engineer to build intelligent agent systems that interact with real-world robotic platforms. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge agent development, multimodal reasoning, and production-grade software engineering.

You’ll help develop an advanced agent harness designed to rival leading coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, while leveraging the unique capabilities of Dimensional OS. Unlike traditional coding agents, our systems must reason over massive volumes of real-world sensor data, extract meaningful insights, and answer complex, context-dependent questions, all while efficiently managing context windows and maintaining performance across long-horizon tasks.

We're looking for engineers who thrive at the intersection of research and production, with the ability to experiment rapidly, solve complex technical challenges, and ship reliable systems, not just prototypes. You might be a former founder, an early engineer at an agent-focused startup, or someone deeply immersed in the modern agent ecosystem with exceptional software engineering fundamentals.

A few examples of what you might work on

  • Evaluate agent performance by modeling real-world robotics scenarios in simulation environments such as MuJoCo and Habitat.

  • Develop advanced agent harnesses capable of processing massive volumes of sensor data while maintaining high performance across long trajectories.

  • Build multimodal reasoning and fact-finding systems that integrate point clouds, images, audio, and text to extract meaningful insights.

  • Design agent memory systems that preserve relevant information across runs, including memory migrations, context organization, and orchestration state management.

  • Develop holistic representations of 3D environments using scene reconstruction and spatial reasoning techniques, enabling agents to efficiently query, interpret, and reason about their surroundings.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain single-agent and multi-agent systems for real-world robotics applications.

  • Develop multimodal agent architectures capable of processing complex sensor data, understanding spatial environments, and interacting with robotic platforms.

  • Build and optimize agent harnesses, including context management, persistent memory systems, and agent orchestration.

  • Develop scalable systems for scene reconstruction, spatial reasoning, and efficient retrieval of information from complex environments.

  • Integrate agent systems into production robotics workflows, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code to a large-scale, shared engineering codebase.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered agent systems, including single-agent and multi-agent architectures.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to deliver reliable, scalable, production-quality code within complex, shared codebases.

  • Experience deploying and maintaining agent systems used by real customers, with an understanding of the technical challenges, failure modes, and performance bottlenecks that emerge at scale.

  • Experience with agent harness engineering, including agentic memory, context management, orchestration, and long-horizon reasoning.

  • Ability to design rigorous evaluation frameworks, define quantitative success metrics, and systematically improve agent performance through experimentation and optimization.

  • Familiarity with modern agent frameworks and tooling, combined with strong product intuition and an understanding of how users interact with intelligent agents.

Bonus (not required)

  • Experience as an early-stage founder or engineer at an agent-focused or AI-native startup.

  • Deep familiarity with contemporary agent research, frameworks, and emerging AI tooling.

  • Proven experience translating experimental or research-driven AI systems into production environments.

  • Experience working with robotics sensor data, including LiDAR, point clouds, joint states, spatial representations, and feature embeddings.

  • Familiarity with scene reconstruction, 3D computer vision, or robotics simulation environments such as MuJoCo and Habitat.

  • Experience with reinforcement learning, automated evaluation, or optimization techniques for improving agent performance.

At Dimensional, accessibility is a fundamental human right. By welcoming diverse perspectives, we help you build a career where you feel you belong.

About This Role

We're looking for an engineer with deep Rust expertise and strong algorithmic fundamentals to work on performance-critical systems. You'll build the low-level infrastructure that powers real-time robotic perception, planning, and control.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement high-performance systems components in Rust.

  • Build and optimize data structures, algorithms, and computational pipelines for real-time robotics workloads.

  • Own performance-critical paths across the platform, from sensor processing to motion planning.

  • Contribute to the design of safe, concurrent systems that run reliably on embedded and edge hardware.

  • Collaborate with robotics and infrastructure teams to deliver integrated, production-quality solutions.

What We Look For

  • Strong Rust experience in production environments.

  • Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and computational complexity.

  • Experience with systems programming -- memory management, concurrency, real-time constraints.

  • Ability to reason about performance at the hardware level (cache behavior, SIMD, memory layout).

  • Track record of shipping reliable, well-tested systems code.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to notable Rust open-source projects.

  • Experience with robotics, real-time systems, or embedded platforms.

  • Background in competitive programming or algorithmic problem-solving.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

About the role

You'll be the first dedicated PM at Dimensional. You'll own the product roadmap end-to-end: talking to users and deployment partners, writing specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making sure what we ship matches what the market needs.

This is not a project management role. You'll be making product decisions every day — what to build, what to cut, what to ship now vs later. You need to be technical enough to read the codebase and opinionated enough to argue with engineers about scope.

What you'll do

  • Own the product roadmap and prioritize features based on customer feedback, deployment partner needs, and engineering constraints

  • Write specs that engineers can build from — clear enough that there's no ambiguity, concise enough that people actually read them

  • Talk to developers, system integrators, and deployment partners weekly to understand what's working and what's not

  • Define success metrics for every feature and track them post-launch

  • Coordinate across SF and Shenzhen teams to keep everyone aligned on what matters

  • Make tradeoff decisions between scope, timeline, and quality — and own the consequences

What we're looking for

  • 3-5+ years of product management experience at a developer tools, infra, or robotics company

  • Have shipped products that developers actually use

  • Technical enough to read code, understand architecture decisions, and call BS on estimates

  • Bonus: experience with robotics, ROS, or hardware-software integration

  • Bonus: Mandarin fluency (we work closely with our Shenzhen team and Chinese OEM partners)

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Firmware
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

About This Role

You will own the layer between DimOS and the silicon. Today, the boundary between our software stack and the hardware underneath it — kernels, drivers, BSPs, vendor firmware — is spread across the team. This seat consolidates it: you make the hardware trustworthy, so that everything above it can assume timing, buses, and drivers simply behave.

This is a deep infrastructure seat with unusual surface area. One week you're writing a kernel driver for a new actuator; the next you're building a BSP for a new compute module, chasing a clock-domain bug in sensor timestamps, or reverse-engineering a sensor vendor's half-documented firmware protocol so the rest of the team never has to think about it.

What you'll do

  • Design, write, and maintain kernel-level drivers for actuators, motor controllers, and sensors across our robot platforms.

  • Build and own board support packages for the compute platforms we ship on (Jetson-class and beyond) — device trees, bootloaders, kernel configs, and power.

  • Integrate and wrangle sensor vendor firmware — evaluating it, working around its bugs, negotiating fixes with vendors, and wrapping it in interfaces the rest of DimOS can trust.

  • Own bus-level communication (CAN/CAN-FD, EtherCAT, UART/RS-485, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, USB) including timing, synchronization, and failure behavior under load.

  • Maintain custom kernel builds: patching, configuring, and upgrading kernels with real-time requirements (PREEMPT_RT-class) as the stack demands.

  • Make firmware work CI-able: HIL rigs, replayed bus captures, and mocks so the distributed team can test hardware behavior without hardware in hand.

  • Write production PRs into the open-source DimOS repo under the same review bar as every other engineer.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of embedded systems design and development in production environments.

  • You have written kernel-level device drivers — for actuators, motor controllers, or comparable real-time peripherals — and shipped them. Not "modified an example driver": designed, debugged, and maintained your own.

  • Real-time reasoning: latency budgets, scheduling and priorities, bounded queues, and a clear answer for what happens when a deadline is missed (degrade gracefully, never silently).

  • Bus and driver depth across CAN, UART, SPI/I²C, Ethernet, USB — written or substantially debugged, not just used.

  • Custom kernel experience: you've configured, patched, and built Linux kernels for embedded targets, and you can reason about what happens between interrupt and userspace.

  • You have built your own BSPs — device trees, bootloaders, Yocto or Buildroot pipelines — for boards that shipped.

  • Experience working with (and around) sensor vendor firmware: integration, protocol debugging, firmware updates, and vendor escalation.

  • Instrument-level debugging: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG/SWD, kernel logs. You have diagnosis stories from below the API.

  • Strong written English and comfort with fully async, distributed collaboration.

Nice to have

  • Rust in production (our native layer is increasingly Rust), or embedded Rust curiosity backed by systems C/C++ depth.

  • NVIDIA Jetson depth: JetPack/L4T, kernel customization, power modes, thermal tuning.

  • PTP/time-sync across multiple compute units; timestamping discipline across clock domains.

  • OTA/fleet update systems (Mender, RAUC, SWUpdate), secure boot, provisioning.

  • Middleware internals — DDS, Zenoh, LCM, shared-memory transports.

  • Board-level literacy: you read schematics, talk to EEs fluently, and can specify a connector unsupervised.

  • Open-source contributions — kernel, U-Boot, Zephyr, Yocto layers, or anything we can read.

Lead end-to-end technical recruiting across the U.S. headquarters and the Shenzhen office — our talent engine in both markets. Dimensional hires with an evidence-heavy pipeline (real-code takehomes, structured evaluations, high bars), and you will run that machine: sourcing exceptional robotics, embedded, and software engineers in both China and the U.S., closing candidates against big-tech offers, and keeping a pipeline moving across 3 time zones.   • 负责美国总部及深圳分部技术类岗位招聘全流程：需求澄清、人才寻访、面试与技术评估协调、背景调查、Offer 谈判及入职跟进。 Own the full recruitment cycle for technical roles across the U.S. headquarters and Shenzhen office: intake, sourcing, interview and technical-evaluation coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding follow-up.

  • 管理 ATS（Ashby）流程、跨时区面试安排、候选人沟通，推进 takehome/PR 评审流程按时闭环。 Manage the ATS (Ashby) pipeline, cross-time-zone scheduling, and candidate communication; keep the takehome/PR-review process closing on time.

任职要求 | Requirements

  • 中英文双语能力为硬性要求：普通话与英语均需达到专业工作水平（听说读写流利）。你每天都要用英文与美国候选人面谈、撰写候选人沟通与内部更新，同时用中文对接国内候选人与渠道。 Mandarin AND English proficiency are hard requirements — professional working fluency in both, spoken and written. You will interview U.S. candidates in English, write candidate communications and internal updates in English, and work Chinese candidates and channels in Mandarin, daily.

  • 必须具备中国大陆与美国两个市场的招聘实战经验：能够举出你在两地分别成功交付的职位。仅有单一市场经验者不符合要求。 Proven ability to recruit in BOTH Mainland China and the U.S. is a hard requirement — you can point to searches you have successfully closed in each market. Single-market experience does not meet the bar.

  • 本科及以上学历，5年以上互联网、科技或相关行业招聘经验，有技术岗位（软件/嵌入式/机器人）招聘成功记录。 Bachelor's degree or above with 5+ years of recruiting experience in internet, technology, or related industries, including a track record hiring technical roles (software / embedded / robotics).

加分项 | Preferred

  • 有猎头/招聘代理公司背景（contingency 或 retained）。 Agency / search-firm background (contingency or retained).

  • 有为美资公司在华招聘或支持跨境招聘的经验；熟悉大湾区机器人/硬件人才生态。 Experience recruiting for U.S. companies in China or supporting cross-border hiring; familiarity with the Greater Bay Area robotics/hardware talent ecosystem.

  • 熟悉现代 ATS 工具（Ashby、Greenhouse、Lever），日常工作中善用 AI 工具。 Fluency with modern ATS tooling (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever) and comfort using AI tools in your daily workflow.

岗位亮点 | Highlights

  • 覆盖美国总部与深圳分部，真正的国际化招聘视野——不是支持角色，而是两个市场的 owner。 True international scope across the U.S. headquarters and Shenzhen — not a support seat, but the owner of both markets.

  • 聚焦顶尖技术人才招聘，深度参与一家开源机器人公司早期团队的搭建；与创始人直接合作。 A focused technical recruiting role building the early team of an open-source robotics company, working directly with the founders.

jobs.title: Logistics Manger - Shenzhen
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

职位概述 | About This Role

负责物流体系的从零搭建、运营和持续优化：机器人、执行器、传感器、计算模块和备件需要从深圳供应商流向美国、欧洲及其他地区的工程师和客户——合法、快速、完好无损。你将统筹国际运输、进出口合规、报关清关、危险品运输（机器人含锂电池）、仓储库存及逆向物流的全链路。没有现成的物流部门等你接手——你来建立整套体系。

Build, operate, and continuously improve our logistics system from scratch: robots, actuators, sensors, compute modules, and spare parts need to move from Shenzhen suppliers to engineers and customers in the U.S., Europe, and beyond — legally, fast, and intact. You will own the full chain: international shipping, import/export compliance, customs, dangerous-goods shipping (robots contain lithium batteries), warehousing and inventory, and reverse logistics. There is no logistics department to inherit — you create the playbook.

岗位职责 | Responsibilities

  • 负责机器人、硬件及零部件的端到端国际运输：询价、订舱、单证、跟踪、交付及异常处理。 Own end-to-end international shipping of robots, hardware, and components: quoting, booking, documentation, tracking, delivery, and exception handling.

  • 负责进出口合规：HS 编码归类、原产地证、商业发票、双向清关、关税策略；掌握重点市场（美国、欧盟及后续新增市场）的国别进口要求与不断变化的关税制度。 Own import/export compliance: HS code classification, certificates of origin, commercial invoices, customs clearance on both ends, and duty/tariff strategy — mastering country-specific import requirements for our key markets (U.S., EU, and beyond) and evolving tariff regimes.

  • 管理危险品运输：锂电池认证（UN38.3、MSDS）、危险品包装与标签、海运/空运承运人限制。 Manage dangerous-goods shipping: lithium battery certification (UN38.3, MSDS), DG packaging and labeling, and air/sea carrier restrictions.

  • 建立并管理货代、报关行和承运人关系；协调内外部资源与供应商，谈判运价，用 SLA 管理服务质量。 Build and manage freight-forwarder, customs-broker, and carrier relationships; coordinate internal and external resources, negotiate rates, and hold vendors to SLAs.

  • 制定并执行库存管理策略：统筹深圳供应链进货物流（拼货整合、质检交接、仓储），监控硬件与备件库存水平，提升周转效率。 Develop and execute inventory management strategy: coordinate inbound supply from Shenzhen-ecosystem vendors (consolidation, QC handoffs, warehousing), monitor hardware and spares stock levels, and improve turnover.

  • 建立和完善逆向物流机制：退货、换货、维修返厂（RMA）及补货处理。 Establish and improve reverse-logistics processes: returns, exchanges, repair (RMA) flows, and replenishment.

  • 跟踪物流运营核心指标，识别流程瓶颈并推动持续改善；前瞻性关注与机器人和计算硬件相关的出口管制动态，在货物被扣之前预警风险。 Track core logistics metrics, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement; stay ahead of export-control considerations relevant to robotics and compute hardware, flagging risks before they become blocked shipments.

  • 文档化一切流程：整个公司是分布式异步协作——你的流程必须让 15 个时区之外的同事一看就懂。 Document everything: the company is distributed and async — your processes must be legible to a teammate 15 time zones away.

任职要求 | Requirements

  • 中英文双语能力为硬性要求：普通话与英语均需达到专业工作水平。上午用中文与深圳供应商谈判，当天下午用英文为美国团队撰写合规摘要。 Mandarin AND English proficiency are hard requirements — professional working fluency in both. You'll negotiate with Shenzhen vendors in Mandarin in the morning and write compliance summaries for the U.S. team in English the same day.

  • 5年以上国际物流/供应链经验，深度负责过电子产品或硬件的跨境运输（不只是国内货运），熟悉物流全流程。 5+ years in international logistics / supply chain with hands-on ownership of cross-border shipping of electronics or hardware (not just domestic freight); familiar with the end-to-end logistics process.

  • 扎实的关务与贸易合规能力：HS 编码、海关估价、清关疑难处理，以及中国出口端与目的国进口端的双向单证规范；熟悉多国进口要求，有"发货前查清楚"的本能。 Deep customs and trade-compliance competence: HS codes, customs valuation, clearance problem-solving, and documentation discipline on both the China export side and destination import side; working knowledge of country-specific requirements across multiple markets — and the instinct to check before shipping, not after seizure.

  • 锂电池/危险品运输经验：UN38.3、包装、标签、承运人规则。 Lithium battery / dangerous-goods shipping experience: UN38.3, packaging, labeling, carrier rules.

  • 出色的货代与报关行管理能力，较强的组织协调、项目推进及跨部门协同能力。 Strong freight-forwarder and broker management, plus organizational, project-management, and cross-functional coordination skills.

  • 具备数据分析能力，能基于运营数据识别问题并提出改进建议；责任心强、抗压能力好、结果导向，能在分布式异步环境中自主、严谨地工作。 Strong data-analysis skills — able to draw insights from operational data and recommend improvements; highly accountable, resilient, results-oriented, and rigorous in a distributed, async environment.

加分项 | Preferred

  • 有机器人、无人机或复杂机电产品的运输经验。 Experience shipping robots, drones, or complex electro-mechanical products.

  • 了解涉及机器人/计算硬件的出口管制体系（如 ECCN 归类意识、受制裁方筛查）。 Familiarity with export-control regimes touching robotics/compute (e.g., ECCN classification awareness, sanctioned-party screening).

  • 有在华外资企业（美资/欧资）工作或合作经验；有从零搭建物流体系的经验。 Experience at or with a foreign-invested (U.S./EU) company in China; experience setting up logistics operations from scratch.

  • 熟悉保税仓、ATA 单证册（展会/演示机器人需要出境）及物流团队管理。 Familiarity with bonded warehousing, ATA carnets (demo/exhibition robots travel), and logistics team leadership.

岗位亮点 | Highlights

  • 主导物流体系从零到一的搭建，直接影响交付效率与客户体验；体系由你定义。 Lead the logistics system from zero to one — your playbook, directly shaping delivery performance and customer experience.

  • 深度参与跨境及海外物流协同：真实机器人发往全球客户与团队，场景复杂且有挑战性。 Deep cross-border and overseas logistics exposure: real robots shipping to customers and teams worldwide, with genuinely complex and interesting problems.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Shenzhen
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

职位概述 | About This Role

我们正在寻找一位细致、靠谱、执行力强的高管助理，为 CEO 及中国区负责人提供高效的日常支持，并推动重要事项顺畅落地。由于公司总部在美国、团队横跨多个时区，这个岗位需要良好的中英文沟通能力和很强的异步协作意识。

We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly reliable Executive Assistant to provide efficient day-to-day support to the CEO and China business leader, and to ensure key priorities are executed smoothly. With a U.S. headquarters and a team spanning many time zones, this role requires strong bilingual communication and comfort with async collaboration.

岗位职责 | Responsibilities

  • 统筹 CEO 及中国区负责人的日程、会议、差旅、访客接待及费用报销等事务。 Manage calendars, meetings, travel, visitor arrangements, and expense reimbursement for the CEO and China business leader.

  • 负责会议筹备、会议纪要、待办事项跟进和跨部门协调（含中美跨时区协调），确保关键事项按时闭环。 Prepare meetings, document minutes, follow up on action items, and coordinate across teams — including across U.S./China time zones — to ensure timely closure of key matters.

  • 协助组织部门例会等内部活动，并支持必要的中英文资料整理与翻译。 Support department meetings and other internal events; organize and translate essential Chinese and English materials.

  • 根据业务需要协助基础数据、报表或财务分析相关工作。 Provide support on basic data, reporting, or financial analysis as business needs arise.

任职要求 | Requirements

  • 本科及以上学历，有 1–3 年高管助理、行政支持或业务助理相关经验优先。 Bachelor's degree or above; 1–3 years of experience in executive assistance, administrative support, or business support is preferred.

  • 中英文双语能力为硬性要求：普通话与英语听说读写均需流利，能够直接支持 CEO 与美国团队的英文沟通，并处理中英文书面材料与翻译。 Mandarin AND English proficiency are hard requirements — fluent in both, spoken and written; able to communicate directly with the CEO and U.S. team in English and handle written materials and translation in both languages.

  • 具备优秀的沟通协调、时间管理能力和保密意识，能妥善处理多任务与紧急事项。 Excellent coordination, time management, and confidentiality awareness; able to handle multiple priorities and urgent tasks effectively.

  • 熟练使用 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等办公软件；有基础财务意识或数据敏感度更佳；善用 AI 工具提升效率者优先。 Proficient in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; basic financial awareness or data sensitivity is a plus; comfort using AI tools to work faster is a plus.

岗位亮点 | Highlights

  • 直接支持核心管理层，接触公司重要业务与跨团队、跨国协作场景。 Direct exposure to senior leadership, key business priorities, and cross-functional, cross-border collaboration.

  • 岗位发展路径清晰，可向业务支持、项目管理或财务分析方向延展。 Clear career development opportunities toward business support, project management, or financial analysis.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dimensional

Dimensional is building the foundation for physical intelligence in general-purpose robotics. We develop a unified framework that enables robots to perceive, reason, learn, and act across diverse real-world environments and embodiments. Dimensional’s mission is to make physical intelligence programmable, scalable, and accessible -- accelerating the development of generalist robots that can adapt, learn, and perform reliably in the real world.

Our platform sits between robot hardware and AI models, providing a modular, composable architecture for training and deploying robotic intelligence at scale. By abstracting hardware differences and standardizing core capabilities—such as perception, spatial understanding, decision-making, and control—Dimensional allows developers and partners to build, transfer, and operate robotic skills efficiently across platforms.

About This Role

We’re looking for full-stack roboticists to own either manipulation or navigation systems end to end. These roles require strong theoretical grounding combined with real-world deployment experience. You’ll be working on robotic arms, mobile robots, and/or legged systems, helping take advanced robotics capabilities from lab-quality to production-ready.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robotic manipulation systems.

  • Deploy and operate robotic systems on real-world hardware.

  • Debug, iterate, and improve real-world robotic behavior in production environments.

  • Collaborate closely with software and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, integrated systems.

Job Requirements:

  • 3+ years in robot manipulation, with work deployed on physical arms

  • Strong Python; experience writing production code with tests and code review

  • Solid robotics math: SE(3), rigid-body transforms, Jacobians, forward/inverse kinematics

  • Motion planning experience (sampling-based planners, collision checking, trajectory generation)

  • Learning: trained ACT, Diffusion Policy, or VLAs (pi-0, OpenVLA, GR00T) with PyTorch; LeRobot or similar data pipelines

  • Hands-on hardware debugging: robot drivers, cameras, grippers, calibration

  • 3D perception basics: point clouds, depth cameras, camera-robot calibration

  • Rigorous testing mindset: designs repeatable experiments and reports success rates

  • Tools: Drake, Pinocchio, MuJoCo or Isaac Sim, Meshcat

Nice to Have

  • Control: real-time control loops, controller arbitration, visual servoing

  • Open-source contributions to robotics or robot-learning projects

  • Proficiency in Rust, Python, C++


Dimensional is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion, supporting all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

 

At Dimensional, accessibility is a fundamental human right. By welcoming diverse perspectives, we help you build a career where you feel you belong.
